algorithm: Discrete Simulated Bifurcation CPU sign-pressure model x_i(t+1)=sign(x_i(t)+eta*sum_j J_ij*x_j(t)-pressure(t))

kv260_resource_estimate.estimate_basis: Dense int8 J matrix plus one dSB update unit; no Vivado synthesis or KV260 board execution performed in this CPU probe.

metadata.exp1387_comparison: Exp 1387 was LUT-limited at 540K LUTs for 15 PT replicas; this dSB estimate fits one 2K-LUT update unit and a 64 KB N=256 int8 J matrix within the KV260 arithmetic budget.
